name: Merge
description: A shimmering opening to the spirit realm in the Eiganjo gardens that disgorged the kami that attacked Norika.

timeline.summary: As children, Norika and Heiko sneak to the tea garden to see a merge, and a faceless kami emerges and attacks.
timeline.quote: Something is shouldering its way through the gap.
